questions.question:
The following histogram shows the marks scored by 40 students in a test of 30 marks. A student has to score a minimum of 10 marks to pass the test.

How many students have scored less than two-third of the total marks?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99d06e35492f2de08ef14a1d1172da75068cf819f511363726cff43c0a10eb7e.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total marks of the test = 30

**Calculation:**

The two-third of the total marks = 30 × (2/3) = 20

The number of students who scored less than 20 = 2 + 8 + 7 + 8 = 25

**∴ The total number of 25 students has scored less than two-thirds of the total marks.**

questions.question:
The number of cars passing the road near a colony from 6 am to 12 noon has been shown in the following histogram.

What is the minimum change percentage in the number of cars in comparison to the previous hour? (correct to 2 decimal places)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b99a14187ffade982b5902d1a2320592a0b9774008c5fe32f9a797f03431d60.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Percentage change in the number of cars between 6AM and 7AM = (105 - 70)/70 × 100% = 50%

Percentage change in the number of cars between 7AM and 8AM = (130 - 105)/105 × 100% = 23.8%

Percentage change in the number of cars between 8AM and 9AM = (115 - 130)/130 × 100% = -11.

questions.question:
Study the histogram and answer the question given below.

The graph represents the number of students obtaining a percentage of marks in class X Board examination in 2018 in a school.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293f7f68ad3e8731cb118a1a7016d2c7f6eac7bdb749543fb27e7e03bb25e0de.png] 

The number of students who have secured less than 60% marks is what per cent less than the number of students who have secured 80% marks and above?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total students who have secured less than 60% = 10 + 30

⇒ 40

Total students who have secured 80 or more than 80% = 40 + 25

⇒ 65

Difference = 65 - 40

⇒ 25

Required % = (25/65) × 100

⇒ 38.46 ≈ 38.5%

**∴ Required answer is 38.5%.**

questions.question:
The given histogram represents the marks of students in Mathematics test of a certain class.

The total number of students is 350.

Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/352d2e12116b9397b99555fe59e8ad0a82a6102e02a5d8ebae3b053a69ddfb91.png] 

What is the ratio of the total number of students who scored 140 marks and above to the total number of students who scored marks between 60 to 120?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total number of students = 350

**Calculation:**

The total number of students who scored 140 marks and above = 55 + 40 + 15 = 110

The total number of students who scored marks between 60 to 120 = 32 + 45 + 60 = 137

The ratio = 110 : 137

∴ The ratio of the total number of students who scored 140 marks and above to the total number of students who scored marks between 60 to 120 is 110 : 137

What is the ratio of the number of male teachers to that of female teachers in Social Science?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of Teachers in Social Science = 40

Percentage of Female = 75%

**Formula Used:**

Total females = Total teachers x Percentage

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of Teachers in Social Science = 40

⇒ Total females = 40 x 75% = 40 x (75/100) = 30 females

⇒ Total males = Total teachers - Total females = 40 - 30 = 10 males

The ratio of males to that of females is

⇒ Number of males: Number of Females = 10: 30= 1: 3

⇒ **Hence, The ratio of the number of males teachers to that of females teachers is 1: 3**

The total number of workers whose daily wages are less than Rs.500 is what percentage more than the total number of workers whose daily wages are Rs.650 and above (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:

% difference = [(Difference in the number of workers having daily wages less than Rs 500 and those having wages Rs 650 and above) / (Workers with daily wages Rs 650 and above)] × 100

**Calculations:**

Workers with daily wages less than Rs 500 = 30 + 45 = 75

questions.question:
Study the given histogram that shows the height (in cm) of 100 students in an athletic team and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c680c18ab22545444ac7719ca58566167e07d3d0761b08cceb89147ffea6cccc.png] 

Express the number of students with height less than 170 cm as the percentage (correct to one decimal place) of the number of students with height more than 160 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There is the histogram that shows the height (in cm) of 100 students in an athletic team

**Calculation:**

The number of students with a height of less than 170 cm = 6 + 12 + 20 =38

The number of students with a height of more than 160 cm = 20 + 24 + 18 + 16 + 4 = 82

The percentage = (38/82) × 100 = 46.34...% ≈ 46.3%

**∴ The number of students with height less than 170 cm is 46.3% of the number of students with height more than 160 cm**
